## 2026-01-24 - Readable Reports
**Learning:** Long-form Markdown reports generated by automation are often difficult to navigate without visual hierarchy and explicit navigation links. Users struggle to find specific sections like "Health" or "Intelligence" in a wall of text.
**Action:** Always include a Table of Contents with explicit HTML anchors (`<a id='...'></a>`) and use emojis in section headers to create visual landmarks for faster scanning.
